Recording rights
Rule 3 — territorial: sound recording public domain in the European Union (pre-1963 publication basis). Documented

Commons applies PD-EU-audio to Richter/Wisłocki’s DG recording attributed to 1959; the dossier preserves the 26–⁠28 April session range. Usable under the programme’s pre-1963 European sound-recording rule; the former 50-year term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is territorial, not a worldwide licence; US sound-recording status is not established. A recording date alone is not represented as an independently verified first-publication date.
